freeze_criterion_disposition.criterion: FREEZE_V1.md section 5: 'OPAQUE: guided dynamics must NOT beat the RAND control'
freeze_criterion_disposition.single_stage_attribution: the criterion measured a hit count; under OPAQUE the objective is constant off the target so no dynamic can use guidance at all, making the hit count a pure coverage lottery in which a 133-vs-129 difference carries no information about guidance
freeze_criterion_disposition.replacement: SD-2d target-independence: same dynamic, same seed, two different targets must emit identical query sequences up to the first hit - exact, mechanical, non-vacuous, and strictly stronger
